component.name: PicList
component.summary: An image upload and cloud storage management tool

description.p: PicList is an efficient and open-source cloud storage and image hosting management desktop application based on PicGo.

ul.li: Support for multiple cloud storage providers (S3, Aliyun OSS, Tencent COS, Qiniu, Upyun, WebDAV, etc.)
Automatic image compression, watermarking, and format conversion
Gallery management and cloud file exploration
Customizable upload keybindings and clipboard watching
